title: Gotedo Impress - Presentations Software for Churches and Businesses - Gotedo Platform
excerpt: Gotedo Impress is a presentation software which provides powerful tools and wide range of media and document support necessary for delightful and impressive presentations.
content_html:
Church and Business Presentations, Impressively and Delightfully Done!

Project beautiful worship and business presentations, documents, images, videos, and bible verse to your audience; and manage media independently across multiple screens - all from one versatile multi-platform desktop software.

Gotedo Impress Features

Every tool your church worship team needs.

From Bible search to live streaming, Impress brings everything into one clean, fast interface

Built-in Bibles Library

Explore Bible translations from the Gotedo Impress Bibles library for use within your church services.

Independent Multi-Screen Output

Gotedo Impress allows you to project different media to different projectors and monitors simultaneously and control each media on each projector independently.

Widest Media & Document Support

Gotedo Impress supports a wide range of media and document types for presentation. You can project PDF, Word, and PowerPoint documents; image formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, TIFF, BMP, WEBP, HEIC/HEIF, etc.; and video formats (planned).

Native Slide Shows

When you need native slide shows for presentations with complex charts, animations, or transitions, Gotedo Impress can launch and control PowerPoint Slide Shows remotely instead of using its embedded slide show technology.

Powerful Media Queue with Media Resumption

Gotedo Impress media queue is the engine of the application. The media queue in Gotedo Impress is persistent ensuring that you do not loose your queued media when you close the application. Gotedo Impress media queue will auto-resume the last slide of any presentation as you toggle between media items.

Video Playback Support

Gotedo Impress supports independent and simultaneous video playback on multiple screens for a wide range of formats include: "MOV", "MP4", "MKV", "WEBM", "AVI", "FLV", "TS", and "OGG". During video playback, you can route audio to any speaker or audio output device of your choice.

Getting Started

Up and running in under five minutes.

Step

1

Download Gotedo Impress

Gotedo Impress is available for Windows and Mac computers. Download and install to get started.

Step

2

Login and Activate

Gotedo Impress licence is free for everyone. Once you launch the software, you will be able to login via your Gotedo Account and activate the software.

Step

3

Connect your Screens

Gotedo Impress supports multiple projectors or monitors. Connect your projectors and Gotedo Impress auto-detects them for independent media per projector — no driver setup needed.

Step

4

Present & Impress

Go live from Gotedo Impress. Effortless present PDF documents, Microsoft PowerPoint / Word documents, Images, Videos, etc. to your audience.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about Gotedo Impress.

Ready to Impress your congregation?

Join 500+ churches already using Gotedo Impress. Create stunning worship presentations and stream with confidence.

Still have questions?

Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Chat with our support team for quick assistance.
